lines: +# Serve each checkpoint in turn and run the fixed eval via the README command.
+for CKPT in sql2b-0919 sql2b-0922 sql2b-0925 sql2b-0927 sql2b-1002 sql2b-1006; do

+  setsid -f bash -c "echo \$\$ > /tmp/sglang.pid; exec python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path /models/$CKPT --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30000" </dev/null >>"/tmp/sglang-$CKPT.log" 2>&1
+    if curl -sf -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:30000/health_generate >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=1; break; fi
+    echo "=== $CKPT: SERVER FAILED TO BECOME HEALTHY ===" >> /tmp/run_all.log
+  # wait until the port is free before starting the next server
